VibePascal v60 Win64 compiler -- a with-statement COM interface prefix is released when the with statement ends, not at routine exit

WHAT CHANGED IN v60 -- A WITH-STATEMENT INTERFACE PREFIX DIES WITH ITS STATEMENT
  GOD's commit message, verbatim in substance: a 'with Make do' prefix is allocated as
  tt_persistent with the with's stmtseq, but only deleted AFTER the with-body -- a
  nested source block -- has advanced stmtcounter. By then its stmtseq is older than
  every later end-of-statement mark, so finalize_statement_temps never releases it and
  the COM interface leaks until routine exit (UT_HolderVerbose scenario 3c). The fix
  re-stamps stmtseq to the freeing statement's counter when a stmtfini temp is freed:
  the statement that frees a slot owns its release. Same-statement temps keep their
  original seq, so no other behaviour changes. GOD measured UT_HolderVerbose 24/24 PASS,
  created=2019 destroyed=2019, still-live=0 on the fixed compiler.

  COMPILER BINARY ONLY. No RTL change, no package change, no PPU FORMAT change, so
  THE UNITS ARE STILL THE v52 SET and auto-update.bat can take the ~3.4 MB bin tarball alone.

HOW THIS CUT WAS VERIFIED ON THIS BOX (lazdev, 2026-09-22; evidence /home/jason/bruno_work/c062/)
  * Self-host fixpoint on x86_64-linux: stage 2 == stage 3 byte-identical (997ec5ec57e8a534a0c16109a71fcbc9).
  * tests/test/tintfstmttemp1.pp + tintfstmttemp2.pp (60 corners): 60/60 with the v60 Linux
    compiler at -O- and -O2; 60/60 with the published v59 Linux compiler (regression control);
    the published v58 Linux compiler scores 23 + 12 = 35 FAILS on the same programs, exactly
    the number RELEASE-v59.txt records, so the harness can fail.
  * WIN64 RUNTIME under wine64 on THESE EXACT BYTES: this ppcx64.exe compiled both matrices
    against the v52 units and the products RAN: 32/32 and 28/28 (created=27 destroyed=27 live=0).
    Same run with the published v59 ppcx64.exe: 60/60. With the published v58 ppcx64.exe: 35 FAILS.
  * dist/win64-runtime-proof.sh: see RELEASE-v60.txt for the run on the published tarball.
  * HONEST LIMIT 1: no reproducer for the scenario-3c leak was found on this box. Sixteen
    with-prefix corners (block body, single-statement body, nested if, for/if/repeat bodies,
    with-in-with) all PASS on BOTH v59 and v60, so the effect of the fix is attested by GOD's
    own UT_HolderVerbose run (24/24 on the fix, per the commit message), not measured here.
    What IS measured here: the fix is in the bytes (source commit, fixpoint), and it regresses
    nothing the 60-corner matrices cover.
  * HONEST LIMIT 2: wine is NOT Windows. v59 has run on native Windows (2026-09-17); this build
    has so far run only under wine64. GOD's IHolder<> test on real Windows is the sign-off.
